info:
TICKER CONFIGURATION
====================
Tickers: VOO (ETF), VTI (ETF), NVDA, HPE, ANET
Alert threshold: ETFs = 1.0% | Individual stocks = 2.0%
Cooldown: 60 min per ticker
Notification channels: Stocks (normal) | stock_alert (<= -2%)

FINNHUB TOKEN
-------------
Read from env var FINNHUB_TOKEN (set in Node-RED add-on config
-> env_vars, then restart the add-on). Market Gate and Tag as
Manual attach it as msg.finnhubToken; the five Fetch URLs use
the mustache placeholder {{{finnhubToken}}}.
The old hardcoded key was exposed in exports — rotated.

SCHEDULES (server local = ET)
-----------------------------
9:25 AM M-F  -> Monarch double-press: press, wait 4 min, press.
                (Monarch dual-update: 1st press requests the
                refresh, 2nd press pulls the data.)
4:00 PM M-F  -> Monarch EOD double-press -> wait 2 min ->
                EOD Batch Fetch -> Daily Summary notification.
EOD1 guards: 3:50-4:30 PM ET window AND a COMPUTED market-open
check (weekday + NYSE holiday calendar, same logic as Market
Gate). No flow-context dependency — restart/redeploy-proof.
(was_open_today is still set by Market Gate but nothing reads
it anymore.)
KNOWN GAP: early-close days (Black Friday, 12/24, 7/3) close at
1 PM; the 4:00 cron + window guard means no EOD summary then.
Accepted trade-off.

EOD2 (401k)
-----------
Trigger: 401k holding sensor state change (unknown/unavailable
transitions ignored at the trigger node).
Gate: weekday + after 4:00 PM ET + once per day (eod2_last_date).
Baseline: HA history state at midnight ET today.

MANUAL = OUT-OF-LINE (never gated, never interferes)
----------------------------------------------------
input_button.portfolio_refresh_now -> bypasses Market Gate
  entirely. Fetches Finnhub prices + writes HA input_numbers at
  any time. Does NOT touch alert levels/cooldowns, open/close
  flags, or send threshold alerts (Process nodes skip alert
  logic when msg._manual is set). Once all 5 tickers land,
  Manual Collect waits 5s for HA writes to settle, then runs
  the EOD Batch Fetch (guards bypassed) and sends a full
  '🔄 Portfolio Snapshot' notification with prices, %, and
  holdings P/L. If a ticker fetch fails, no snapshot is sent
  (check debug for 'no data' warns).
input_button.eod2_trigger_now -> runs EOD2 immediately, bypasses
  weekday/time/dedup gates, and does NOT set eod2_last_date, so
  the automated EOD2 still fires later. Title tagged 🔄.

TEST NODES
----------
TEST: Trigger EOD Summary -> msg._test=true bypasses EOD1 guards.
TEST: Trigger EOD2 -> payload._test=true bypasses EOD2 gates,
  never sets eod2_last_date. Title tagged 🧪.
TEST: Alert Notification -> formats a fake alert, no data written.

TO ADD A TICKER
---------------
1. Duplicate node chain:
   Fetch HTTP -> Process -> Alert Gate -> Format Alert
   Process -> Build HA Calls -> Split -> HA Service Call
2. In Process node update flow-context prefix + threshold
   (1.0 ETF / 2.0 stock). Keep the msg._manual guard.
3. In Build HA Calls update input_number entity IDs.
4. In Fetch URL update the Finnhub symbol (keep {{{finnhubToken}}}).
5. In Market Gate reset block add {ticker}_last_alert_pct/_time.
6. Wire the new Fetch node from BOTH Market Gate output 1 AND
   Tag as Manual output 1.
7. In EOD Batch Fetch add the input_numbers + Monarch sensor.
8. In EOD Format Summary add fmt() line, holdingKeys, tickerMap.
9. Update HA dashboard YAML (cards, P&L calc, graphs, sankey).

HA ENTITY PREFIXES
------------------
VOO  -> sp500  (input_number.sp500_*)
VTI  -> vti
NVDA -> nvda
HPE  -> hpe
ANET -> anet

MONARCH HOLDING SENSORS
-----------------------
VOO  -> sensor.monarch_holding_voo
VTI  -> sensor.monarch_holding_vti
NVDA -> sensor.monarch_holding_nvda
HPE  -> sensor.monarch_holding_hpe
ANET -> sensor.monarch_holding_anet
401k -> sensor.monarch_holding_401k
